decisions.reason: It is a flagship extension of the firm's core vessel-management offer into offshore and renewable energy markets, which fits its expansion and sustainability strategy.
It is a close, low-risk add-on to existing crew and corporate support services, even if it is less strategic and more exposed to market disruption than core management activities.
As a flagship digital service that strengthens customer proximity and operational transparency, it supports the firm's broader service scope and scalable delivery model.

The app aligns with safer, cleaner and more efficient vessel operations, but as a narrower digital tool it has the highest chance of being folded into another service rather than continued as a standalone product.
